name: 会話の通知と写真保存の設定群
prompt:
Recreate only the three-row WhatsApp contact settings card from the original screenshot crop as an isolated Japanese UI component on a 390x188 canvas. Use the original screenshot crop for the card geometry, icons, row spacing, rounded white card on a light-gray page, and subtle separators. Use the native preview for the exact Japanese copy and value states.

Rows, top to bottom: a black outlined notification bell, label 「通知」, gray value 「設定する」, light-gray chevron; a black outlined artist palette matching the original Chat theme icon, label 「会話の背景」, gray value 「設定する」, light-gray chevron; an outlined save-to-photos tray/arrow icon, label 「写真に保存」, gray value 「保存しない」, light-gray chevron. Keep the labels Meiryo Regular 14px/24px in #1D1D1D and the values Meiryo Regular 12px/16px in #6E6E6E. Keep exactly two separators between the three rows and no bottom divider. Use a pure-white rounded card around x16..374 on a uniform light-gray page background; no card border or shadow.

These are navigational action rows with icons and chevrons, not hyperlink text. The native text metadata has link:null for every label and value. Do not color any text blue. The user requires blue for real hyperlinks, and this component has none.

Do not add a contact header, avatar, status bar, other settings rows, buttons, new copy, gradients, or decorative effects. Keep the component compact, crisp, and faithful to the original screenshot. The editable native preview uses a photo placeholder for the middle icon; the original screenshot's palette icon is the protected source artwork for this row.
reviewNotes: Candidate 1 preserves all Japanese labels/values and uses the original notification, palette and save-to-photos icons. Counts/states and chevrons stay gray. Residual: the white card is about 17px too tall at 390px width; first row sits about 6px high and third row about 6px low relative to the screenshot crop, stretching the row rhythm. Needs a second pass.
